ideas.title: Non-profit Fraud: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of non-profit fraud and the measures being taken to prevent it.
questions: What are the most common types of non-profit fraud?
How can donors protect themselves from non-profit fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread non-profit fraud and to hold those responsible accountable. It would require in-depth research and interviews with experts in the field.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Closer Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the high risk of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the measures being taken to prevent it.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent Medicaid fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and to identify measures to prevent it in the future. It would require in-depth research and analysis of Medicaid data.
